mnc.review:
Mnc sir er class onk engaging try to sit at the front.Uni manush er nam o mone rakhe so try to interact.Uni class e onk casually discuss kore easily concept gula bujhay dey.Unar kotha shunle bujhe and slides theke bujhei u are good to go.
Mcq thakena quiz/mid/final e broad question thakle.Unnecessary boro kora lagena ja chaise nijer moto explain korte parlei marks dey
Nashin Islam his lectures might feel a bit sketchy... MNC gives pretty easy and straightforward mid & final questions overall and he’s quite strict during exam invigilation.
